definitions.ts_near: TS-near (FT-1) = kind ts_near / ts_imag / ts_label / d0_ts_near / d0_ts_imag / d0_ts_label / d0_ts_grad, or kind ts_path / ts_final / g2_path / ts_final_g2 / al_ts / d0_g2_path / d0_ts_final_g2 / nur_ts_path / nur_ts_final / nur_tsguess_opt / nur_path / nur_neb / nur_fwd_bwd with dform_label_A <= 0.3 A (max over the two forming bonds of |d - d_label|, label TS + formed_pairs_ts; computed here for single-D1-reaction records without one; D0 records carry it from gen_dft collect --d0, against the D0 label TS; Nurion target-job records from inv_nurion scan, against the label TS). D0 rows without D1 rxn_ids are train-only, so the D0 kinds change only the train n_ts_near count, never an FT-1 metric (Phase I d0_ts_path / d0_ts_final are therefore not added). nur_x_* (non-target jobs) are never TS-near: no rxn_ids, and their dform_own_A is against their own TS, not a label TS. nur_ts_final is TS-near only within 0.3 A (as Phase I ts_final; N_report 11-04: 51 of 6,740 are farther), although tier 2 of FT-cap takes it always.
definitions.rel_e: within-reaction relative energy: structures of one reaction (single rxn_id) and one composition, E - mean(E) of the group (groups of >= 2), MAE over structures; primary on TS-near structures, also on all single-reaction structures. MACE uses interaction_energy (no float32 E0 quantisation).
definitions.force_mae: mean |F_pred - F_ref| over Cartesian components, kcal mol-1 A-1

note: FT-1 is recorded only (spec 5), the gate is FT-2 geometry
